item.wieldyourpower.entity_viewer.toolti: Right-click an entity to inspect it and get quick kill commands.
wieldyourpower.screen.title: WieldYourPower - Self Limits
wieldyourpower.tip.speed: Absolute horizontal momentum cap (blocks/tick): -1 = off, 0 = stop; vanilla walk ~0.216, sprint ~0.281, creative flight ~0.545.
wieldyourpower.tip.step: Step height coefficient of the vanilla 0.6: -1 = off, 1 = vanilla, 0 = cannot step up.
wieldyourpower.tip.creativeDefense: Creative players can't be killed by other mods; /wyp kill still pierces. No death screen; blocks hurt/setHealth and other lethal paths, plus base-value and per-tick restore.
wieldyourpower.tip.creativeMinHealth: Every tick keep a protected creative player's health at least this high.
wieldyourpower.tip.creativeMinMaxHealth: Every tick keep a protected creative player's max health (base value) at least this high.
wieldyourpower.tip.creativeHitboxMode: Experimental: hide the protected creative player from entity lookups. Default removes the hitbox except while sneaking on the ground.
wieldyourpower.tip.killPierces: Enhanced /wyp kill pierces invulnerability, totems and event cancellation.
wieldyourpower.tip.killForceRemoval: Last-resort entity-manager teardown for mobs that survive removal. Players are never world-removed.
wieldyourpower.tip.killClearBossBars: On a forced kill, hide the target's ServerBossEvent so its boss bar does not linger.
wieldyourpower.tip.bossDespawnCompat: LAST RESORT, OFF: ask the target's own mod to despawn it via keyword reflection (bytecode-scanned). Only if you trust your pack.
wieldyourpower.tip.killHonor: Entries: tag,<tag>, type,<entity id>, uuid,<uuid>. Matching targets only get a normal death attempt (no forced kill).
wieldyourpower.tip.freezeDuration: Default freeze duration in ticks when the command omits it.
wieldyourpower.tip.freezeRadius: Default radius (blocks) to also freeze non-players around each target; 0 = targets only.
wieldyourpower.tip.viewerReach: Extra reach (blocks) for the viewer's own ray trace. 0 disables.
wieldyourpower.tip.viewerHitbox: Extra hitbox size for the viewer's ray trace (helps aiming). 0 disables.
wieldyourpower.tip.viewerSelectDrops: Allow the viewer to select dropped item entities.
wieldyourpower.tip.viewerCooldown: Cooldown in ticks between viewer inspections. 0 = off.
wieldyourpower.tip.authorsFavorFilter: Comma-separated matchers deciding which non-player entities get the protection: tag,<tag> / type,<entity id> / uuid,<uuid>. A colon inside an id is kept.
wieldyourpower.tip.authorsFavorDamage: Change-based mitigation for setHealth that bypasses the vanilla damage chain: new = floor((current - requested) * coefficient). Negative values count as 0. 0 = off, 1 = the drop is fully absorbed.
wieldyourpower.tip.authorsFavorMaxHealth: Hard floor for a max-health cut, relative to the historical max. 0 = off, 1 = cuts fully reversed.
How much of a max-health cut takes effect. 1 = full (no protection).
wieldyourpower.tip.ally_protection: Protected entities (tag,<tag>/type,<id>/uuid,<uuid>). Only damage from a player is blocked; /wyp kill always pierces.
wieldyourpower.tip.mine_speed: Minimum ticks to break a block. Larger = slower. -1 = mining forbidden.
wieldyourpower.tip.mine_interval: Cooldown in ticks between block breaks. 0 = off.
wieldyourpower.config.authorsFavorDamage: setHealth mitigation coefficient (0 = none, 1 = fully absorbed)
wieldyourpower.tip.attribute: One per line: attribute,<attribute id>,<max>, e.g. attribute,minecraft:generic.max_health,40
entity_viewer.name: Name
entity_viewer.invulnerable: This entity is invulnerable to normal damage.
entity_viewer.button.tooltip: Click to fill the chat with: %s (press Enter to run)
